reason: B provides the clearer, more physically plausible and falsifiable mechanism: annealing-induced Mg partitioning and grain-boundary intermetallic precipitation disrupt passivating Al/Ti-rich scales, with defined electrochemical, oxidation, and microstructural comparisons. Its cited SPS/Cantor-alloy evidence is only indirect and does not establish the proposed transformation, but A is substantially vaguer and its assumption that Mg-rich intermetallics necessarily promote a continuous protective Mg–Al oxide scale is less well supported.
